title: The Kaleidoscopic Filter on the Partition Manifold, Part I: The Simplicial Ehrhart, Barycentric Pascal Product, and Continuous Bernoulli Exact Closed Forms for $p(n)$
summary: The partition function $p(n)$ has historically been constrained by recursive series and asymptotic approximations, coupling evaluation to sequential memory bottlenecks. Here we derive three exact, non-recursive closed-form identities for $p(n)$ and $p_k(n)$. Via the Stratified Simplicial Decomposition (SSD) of the Ehrhart partition polytope in the affine $A_{k-1}$ Weyl group, we establish the Rational Structure Theorem and cross-convolution operator $\mathcal{B}_k$, proving $p_k(n)$ is computable in strictly $\mathcal{O}_k(1)$ time.
